title: Before Bittu Tabahi, actor Madhavan had praised an Andhra man's fight to clean an ancient stepwell. 300 volunteers came forward to help
description: Abbayi Kanth's social media post drew attention to a disgracefully polluted temple well in Andhra Pradesh, sparking a remarkable response, even earning praise from actor R Madhavan. More than 300 passionate volunteers mobilized for a thorough cleanup, successfully restoring the well's historical charm. The event not only cleaned up the site but also educated community members about responsible waste disposal and the significance of safeguarding cultural heritage.
